name: KN-23
material_notes: Non-separating maneuvering quasi-ballistic missile (Iskander/9K720-class, DPRK KN-23). The whole airframe reenters and maneuvers - there is no separate RV, so body_tps_material = the airframe material acting as a HOT STRUCTURE (steel, group=metal -> bondline collapses onto the airframe limit; §10.1). The binding hot spot is the control-surface/fin LE and windward flank during the terminal pull-up, evaluated at the body location with the airframe limit (§0 maneuvering archetype). ALL numbers are OPEN-SOURCE SCREENING ESTIMATES: mass ~1.5 t warhead on a ~3.4 t missile - here mass_kg=500 is a warhead-section screening value; beta/L-D/nose_radius are quasi-ballistic-maneuvering estimates, not a published fit. Refine when better data is available.
source: Screening estimate. DPRK KN-23 short-range ballistic missile, Iskander-M (9K720) analog: depressed/quasi-ballistic ~50 km apogee, ~450-690 km range, terminal pull-up maneuver, Mach ~6-7. Non-separating unitary airframe. No published aero/thermal fit - values are open-source order-of-magnitude estimates.
